RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the August 10, 2007/Sravana 19, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
1
Banned injection in circulation
†*1. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Oxadicin, an injection injected to buffalo is
being sold in the country despite a ban on
the same;
(b) whether it is being used to increase
the size of vegetable artificially by injecting
it in fruit and vegetable plants in the country;
(c) if so, whether public health is being
affected adversely by its use;
(d) whether Government would take
strict action to prevent the sale of the said
injection; and
(e) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Compensation to dependents of the
victims of Mumbai blasts
*2. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of dependents of the
victims of suburban Mumbai rail bomb
blasts of 11 July, 2006, to whom Railways
have, so far, offered/given employment;
(b) the nature of jobs offered/given;
(c) whether it is a fact that even
graduates and post-graduates have been
offered only class IV appointments, if so,
the reasons therefor;
(d) whether his Ministry would follow
a rational policy and give at least class III
appointments to graduates and post-
graduates; and
(e) by when a decision thereon is likely
to be taken?
Increase of medical facilities
†*3. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of major
Government hospitals functioning in the
country;
(b) the number of people getting medical
facilities in each hospital in the country
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
and the average of the same in Uttarakhand;
and
(c) the details of the steps to be taken
to increase the availability of medical
facility in the Tenth Five Year Plan?
Bird flu in Manipur
*4. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are well aware
about the bird flu in Manipur State
recently;
(b) if so, what steps have been taken in
this regard and for the prevention of similar
flu in other States;
(c) the total number of poultry birds
killed and expected to be killed for the
protection of such and other birds in the
country; and
(d) whether this flu has reached India
from China, Tibet or Nepal?
Election to general body/delegates of
CGECCS Ltd.
*5. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as per the provisions of
Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act,
2002 and bye-law No. 23 (ii) of Central
Government Employees Consumer
Cooperative Society Ltd. (Kendriya
Bhandar), Board of Directors (BoD) are
responsible to conduct election to the
general body/delegates within the stipulated
period;
(b) whether election to the general body/
delegates was conducted in the year 1999
for a period of three years and if so, the
reasons for not ensuring the elections when
they became due; and
(c) the action taken by Central
Registrar, MSCS to conduct the election
on time and to declare BoD ineligible for
continuation/further election as delegate/
member of the Board?
Packages for Vidarbha and its
monitoring
†*6. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of packages announced
for the farmers of Vidarbha area of
Maharashtra during the year 2006-07;
(b) the amount provided to the farmers
of Vidarbha from these packages;
(c) whether any inquiry has been
conducted by Government to ascertain that
funds are reaching the farmers or not; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
enable farmers to get rid of debt and
overcome any crisis they may face in the
course of cultivation in the near future?
Import of wheat
†*7. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the countries from
where wheat is being imported by
Government to meet the shortage of wheat
in the country along with the quantity being
imported from each country;
(b) the rate of wheat being imported;
(c) the reasons for not purchasing wheat
from Pakistan and Australia;

3
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) whether Government would ensure
that the wheat being imported from America
is free of weeds; and
(e) the quantity of wheat required for
the country?
Insecticides banned or under review
†*8. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
insecticides have been banned in the
country and some others have been put
into the "Review List";
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are aware that
inspite of the ban the insecticides are being
sold in the market;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether Government are
contemplating to formulate a policy in this
regard to prevent the adverse effects of
insecticides?
Patenting of indigenous seeds by
multinational companies
†*9. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some of the
multinational companies are misleading the
poor farmers by patenting indigenous seeds
in the name of GM (Genetically Modified);
(b) if so, the action taken by
Government against such companies and
the efforts made to check it; and
(c) the effort being made by
Government for scientific study and
development of the indigenous seeds?
Chikungunya in Kerala
*10. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the reported spreading of
Chikungunya in Kerala in large scale,
affecting thousands of people and resulting
in the death of a number of people;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a Central team consisting
of scientists and experts was sent to the
State to assess the situation;
(d) if so, the details and findings thereof;
and
(e) the details of the assistance extended
by the Central Government to the State
Government to fight the disease?
Fever in Kerala
*11. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the Kerala State is witnessing an outbreak
of fever epidemic;
(b) if so, what action Government have
taken in this regard;
(c) whether the State Government has
requested any assistance from the Central
Government, if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the total number of deaths due to
fever epidemic in Kerala during the last six
months?

4
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Chikungunya in the country
*12. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
called an emergency meeting of Health
Ministers of nine States in the month of
June, 2007 in the wake of reports of
Chikungunya spreading across the country
after its outbreak in Kerala;
(b) whether according to his Ministry,
Chikungunya  is likely to stay for 3-4 more
years in the country;
(c) if so, whether the Central
Government have promised a special
package for Chikungunya affected States
to deal with the disease;
(d) whether Government have allocated
Rs. 20 crore to fight Chikungunya in the
country; and
(e) if so, what concrete measures have
been taken, so far?
Election by secret ballot
†*13. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the state of preparedness to hold
secret ballot by September, 2007 as per
the order of the court for granting
recognition to unions; and
(b) steps being taken by Government
to recognize all the registered unions for
ensuring fair elections?
Conversion of fertile land into
industrial area
*14. DR. E.M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry is aware of
the conversion of fertile land into industrial
area leading to migration and decrease of
agricultural production in rural area; and
(b) if so, what are the steps taken by
inter-Ministerial meeting to regulate the
same?
Family welfare centres in the country
†*15. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of family welfare centres
working in the country, State-wise;
(b) the amount allocated for the same
during the last three years, State-wise;
(c) whether the amount allocated by
Government during this period for family
welfare in the country has been fully
utilised; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
New rail services
†*16. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state whether
Government would consider to start rail
services on the routes from Amritsar to
Mumbai via Hanumangarh-Bikaner-
Jodhpur-Ahmedabad, from Jaipur to Puri
via Kota-Bina-Katni-Bilaspur-Jabalpur-
Sambalpur-Bhuvaneshwar, from Jaipur to
Kanyakumari via Jodhpur-Ahmedabad-
Konkan rail route-Coimbatore-Cochin-

5
Trivendram, and from Ajmer to Bhopal via
Chittaurgarh-Kota-Baran-Bina-Bhopal?
Cancer treatment in Delhi
*17. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) how many hospitals in Delhi have
been empanelled for specialized treatment
in cancer;
(b) whether empanelled hospitals are
providing free/cashless treatment to
pensioners;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) what Government are doing to
ensure that pensioners are given free/
cashless treatment in specialized hospitals?
Production of wheat
†*18. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
the final assessment made by Government,
the production of wheat has increased in
comparison to the previous first assessment
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
quantum of production estimated by
Government in the first and final assessment
respectively; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that as per
the assessment made by private agencies
the production of wheat is estimated to be
78 million tons, if so, the reasons for
difference in the assessments made by
Government and private agencies?
Electrification of rail lines in Uttar
Pradesh
†*19. SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of railway lines for which
the plan of electrification has been
formulated by Government in the year
2007-08; and
(b) the names of railway lines in Uttar
Pradesh for which there is a proposal of
electrification and renewal?
Vacant posts of agricultural scientists
†*20. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of posts of agricultural
scientists lying vacant in different
agriculture universities and agriculture
science centres as on 31st March, 2007
and since when they are lying vacant;
(b) the effect of vacant posts of scientists
on agricultural research and agriculture
schemes; and
(c) the action taken by Government to
fill the vacant posts of agricultural scientists
and by when these posts are likely to be
filled?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 4th August, 2007 Secretary-General.

Inclusion of Orissa under NHM
4. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) how many districts of Orissa have
been included under National Horticulture
Mission; and
(b) the details of measures that are
proposed to be taken for development of
horticulture in Orissa?
Horticulture college in Orissa
5. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether ICAR proposes to provide
funds for establishment of one Horticulture
College in Orissa under OVAT and for
development of horticulture sector in the
State; and
(b) if so, the details along with the status
of the project?
Special mission for wheat, rice and
pulses
†6. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to
launch a special mission very soon in order
to increase the production of wheat, rice
and pulses; and
(b) if so, whether any other programme
is also proposed to increase the growth rate
of agriculture sector alongwith the above
programme?
Promotion of vermi compost and bio-
fertilizers
†7. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) the percentage of wastes from urban
and rural areas of the country being used
for preparing vermi compost and other bio-
fertilizers;
(b) whether the wastes from the urban
and rural areas of the State of Uttarakhand
are also being used for preparing vermi
compost and other bio-fertilizers; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
measures taken by Government so far to
encourage it?
Sale of spurious fertilizers, pesticides
and insecticides
8. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that spurious
fertilizers, pesticides and insecticides are
being sold in some parts of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and its
impact on agriculture produce;
(c) the number of cases that has come
to light during last two years; and
(d) the steps taken to prevent production
of spurious fertilizers, pesticides and
insecticides?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

NATPs recommendations on
agricultural research
9. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Agricultural
Technology Project of World Bank has
given any recommendations to help Indian
agricultural research by making it more
responsive to the technology needs at the
grassroots; and
(b) if so, how the farming systems in
the disadvantaged  rain fed regions like
Vidarbha where a large number of farmers
are resorting to suicides due to poverty
level being high especially in districts like
Yavatmal would get the intended benefits
and relief envisaged in NATP through
sustainable use of natural resources land
and water?
Guidelines on NATP
10. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether detailed guidelines have
been issued on the recommendations made
in the World Bank aided National
Agricultural Technology Project,
completed in June, 2006 costing US$ 249
Millions;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof;
and
(c) whether any specialized agency has
been created which would help the poor/
marginal farmers to derive maximum
intended advantages?
Committee on bringing reform in
agriculture
11. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to  state:
(a) whether farmers get around 30 per
cent portion of the final price of agricultural
product and the remaining 70 per cent
portion is received by middlemen brokers
and stockist agents;
(b) if so, whether Government have
taken any steps to constitute  a high level
committee to bring about reform in
agriculture and economic sectors related
thereto; and
(c) if so, by when the report of this
committee is likely to be received?
Special plan for wheat, rice and
pulses
12. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to  state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are planning to implement a special plan
for  wheat, rice and pulses at its own
expenses;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the States and Union Territories
being covered under the scheme and
allocation of funds being made during
2007-08; and
(d) the results anticipated from the
special plan during 2007-2008 and 2008-
09?
Crop damage
13. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR : Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to  state:

4
(a) whether an assessment of the
damage caused to the crops due to
excessive rainfall in some States of the
country  during the current monsoons has
been made; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
assistance provided to the States to
compensate the farmers, State-wise?
Target for production of pulses
14. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA : Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of target fixed by
Government for production of pulses in the
country during the next two years;
(b) the details of quantity of pulses
produced in the country  during the last
three years, State-wise;
(c) whether this quantity is sufficient
to meet the present requirement of the
country; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor and the
details of effective steps being taken by
Government to increase the production of
pulses in the country?
Budget provision  for foodgrain seeds,
oil seed, etc.
†15. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to  state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the provision
for foodgrain seeds, oil seeds, pulses, maize
development, crops insurance scheme, land
and water conservation in the budget
estimates for the year 2007-08 has been
fixed less than the budget estimates for the
year 2006-07; and
(b) whether this provision would  be
sufficient  to fulfill the shortfall in the
production  of foodgrains, pulses, oil seeds
and their development schemes?
Suicides in Vidarbha
†16. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS;
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to  state:
(a) whether the suicides  by the farmers
in Vidarbha goes unabated;
(b) whether the Prime Minister’s
package has been implemented; and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take to make the farmers free from debt all
over the country?
Crop loss
17. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to  state:
(a) whether an estimate of the  losses
caused to crops in the northern region of
the country during 2006-07 due to winter
heavy rains and  hailstorms has been made;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the central assistances, if any,  given
to States, to compensate the affected
farmers, State-wise?
Per capita availability of foodgrains
†18. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to  state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the  food
security crisis in the country is getting
intensified at present;

5
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
per capita availability of foodgrain in the
country was 192 grams during 1991 to
1995  which has reduced to 174 grams
during 2004-2007;
(c) if not, the  facts in this regard; and
(d) the target fixed by Government to
increase the per capita availability of the
foodgrains for ensuing years?
Revision of assistance package on
suicides of farmers
19. SHRI JANARDHANA POOJARY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleasesd to state:
(a) whether suicide by debt-ridden
farmers in various parts of the country,
particularly, Maharashtra and Karnataka,
continues unabated;
(b) if so, the details for the last three
years with  the details of assistance
extended to the farmers to alleviate their
problems, State-wise;
(c) whether  the package of assistance
announced by Government last year has not
found favour with the farmers; and
(d) if so, the details  and the measures
proposed to be taken to revise the scheme
of assistance?
Suicides in Andhra Pradesh
20. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY : Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to  state:
(a) whether the farmers are committing
suicides in many States due to various
reasons;
(b) if so, the details of such suicides
reported especially in Andhra Pradesh
during the last three years, year-wise and
district-wise and the reasons therefor;
(c) the relief amount  granted  to such
famalies  through special  packages in each
case especially  in Andhra Pradesh;
(d) whether the Prime Minister had also
announced some  relief packages especially
for Andhra Pradesh;
(e) if  so, the details thereof;
(f) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(g) the future action plan prepared to
keep farmers happy in all  the States to
prosper the farmers as well as our country
in future?
Suicides by farmers in Haryana and
Punjab
†21. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of farmers in the country
who have committed suicide during last
two years;
(b) the number of such farmers of
Haryana and Punjab who have committed
suicde;
(c) whether the dependents of such
deceased farmers of Haryana and Punjab
are being given any special package on the
lines of Vidarbha by Government;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(f) whether any plan is proposed/under
consideration of Government to prevent
such suicides?
Hiring tuna training boats
22. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
permission to the Central Institute of
Fisheries Nautical and Engineering
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

6
Training (CIFNET) to hire tuna training
boats from Norway and other countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how many people would be trained
on hired tuna boat in a year;
(d) whether it would be cheaper to send
Indian youths for training abroad at much
lower costs; and
(e) the steps proposed to study the costs
of training with hired boats, etc. by
CIFNET?
Decline in fish catches
23. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there  is a large population
of fishermen who obtain fish catches from
rivers in India;
(b) whether Government have received
representations that surveys should be
conducted on impact of dams on rivers and
the subsequent decline in fish resources;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken to protect the livelihood of fishermen;
(e) whether Government propose to
create alternate economic avenues for
fishermen who lose their employment due
to dams on rivers;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Drip Irrigation Scheme
24. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a)  whether Government have
prepared/proposed to prepare any action
plan for Drip Irrigation Scheme under
centrally sponsored scheme on Micro
irrigation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the target fixed along with the extent
to which they have been achieved during
the last two years State-wise; and
(d) the funds allocated and released
thereunder during this period State-wise?
Agricultural production
25. SHRI K.CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is fall
in the rate of agricultural production
particularly in the production of wheat and
rice;
(b) if so, whether Government
ascertained the causes for the fall in
production of these produces;
(c) whether Government have taken/
proposed to take measures to increase
investment in the infrastructure
development in the agricultural sector; and
(d) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the details of the funds earmarked for the
purpose?
Cultivable land
26. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY: Will
